result.raw_final:
Yes. An American citizen planning to work in the UK in healthcare for more than 6 months generally needs a work visa. For an eligible healthcare role, the main route is the [Health and Care Worker visa](https://www.gov.uk/health-care-worker-visa). You need a qualifying job offer from a Home Office-approved employer and a certificate of sponsorship; the role and salary must also meet the visa requirements. The visa can last up to 5 years and can be extended if you remain eligible.

GOV.UK’s [Health and Care Worker visa guidance](https://www.gov.uk/health-care-worker-visa) is the source. **FINAL ANSWER: Yes—an American generally needs a UK work visa to work in healthcare for longer than 6 months. For an eligible role, apply for a Health and Care Worker visa with a qualifying sponsored job offer.**
